bio: Art meets gastronomy at 18 rue Troyon. This discreet restaurant with a modern façade is named after L'Abbaye de Thélème, a utopia conjured up by Rabelais. Rudy Langlais and his team create cuisine with plenty of personality, in which carefully selected ingredients and flavours from Japan come together in refined and delicate dishes, neatly combining French and Japanese styles. The work is meticulous, and the bill for lunch remains reasonable. Good recommendations from the sommelier....
